design_specification.subject: two broad paper strips forming one open offset zigzag join
design_specification.idea: Separate phrases become one coherent rhythm: two unequal strips align through one broad offset joint.
design_specification.construction: A wide horizontal ink strip bends down at its right third; a shorter coral strip bends upward from lower left. One deliberate rectangular paper gap remains between them. Use the same thickness and generous rounded outer elbows, flat blunt terminals. Offset the overall mass slightly upward for optical balance; no loops, tiny slivers, wedges or pointed near-tangencies.
design_specification.color: Ink is the dominant three-quarter mass, coral marks the shorter joined phrase; warm paper is the open channel and surrounding field.
design_specification.material: Flat broad planes; no glossy lighting or gradient needed.
design_specification.reference: Take shared curvature and spacing grammar from Craft, not its cross shape, part count or color map.
design_specification.small_size: The broad open right-angle channel and unequal terminal lengths remain distinct at 32px.
design_specification.difference: An open horizontal gesture rather than a closed note or a paper object.
design_specification.risk: May become an arbitrary interlock; keep two blunt ends and no closed orbit/infinity loop.
